fee_notes: Standard royalty is 8% of weekly gross receipts; range of 5%-10% applies under incentive/expansion programs (5%-7% for qualifying existing franchisees opening additional studios; 10% for franchisees operating under the legacy released-territory program being phased out). Minimum annual royalty based on assumed annual gross receipts of $175,000 applies beginning in year 2 (implying ~$14,000/year minimum). National Advertising Contribution is up to 2% of weekly gross receipts; franchisee must also spend at least 12% of annual gross receipts total on advertising and public relations (amounts paid to national fund count toward this 12%). Tech fee is $150/month for Agenda Master Software license. Website Licensing Fee currently $0 but expected to begin in 2026 at estimated $250-$350/month. Additional fees include: Check Handling $30; Interest 1.5%/month on late amounts; Teaching Time reimbursement currently $50/personal lesson (capped increase of 10%/year); Contest Entry $50-$200/person; Audit reimbursement of costs; Lobbying up to $1,000+ per franchisee share; Liquidated Damages (rule violation) $7,500; Demand Note $25,000; Liquidated Damages (trademark infringement) 25% of weekly gross receipts; Convention $625; Administrative Fee $100/report past due; Liquidated Damages (unauthorized participation) higher of 25% of revenues or $10,000; Liquidated Damages (required meetings) $1,000/meeting; Administrative Transfer Fee $5,000.

Royalty | 5% - 10% of weekly gross receipts | Due by Friday of each week on previous week's gross receipts | "Gross receipts" mean all monies you receive for instruction, lessons, services, parties, competitions, trips, clubs, memberships and similar services

Agenda Master Software License Fee | $150 per month | Payable monthly | We have developed software for use in connection with your operation of your studio (the "Agenda Master Software"). You must license the Agenda Master Software from us.
2/ Our standard royalty is 8%. Beginning with the second year of your Studio's operation, you must pay minimum annual royalty fees based on assumed annual gross receipts of $175,000.
3/ You must spend at least 12% of the Studio's annual gross receipts on advertising and public relations. Any amounts you pay to a National Advertising Fund we establish, or an advertising or public relations program in which other franchisees participate, count toward this percentage.
